name: hae-n-ir-ext-kdf
recipe: ir-ext-kd: trained from scratch for 90 epochs on HIT-UAV trainval (32% of crops) + AIResQ train (16%) + WiSARD IR train (40%) + AOS thermal integral images train (8%) + RGB-LWIR Air train (4%); thermal only; train-time scale jitter 0.9-2.4; copy-paste 0.3; soft negatives (neg_decay=1.0); fine stem; knowledge distillation from an unreleased hae-s teacher trained by the hae authors on the same data mix (teacher input x1.333; cls alpha 0.5, box alpha 0.3, feature imitation). Evaluated during training at x1.5; recommended deployment scale x1.0
training_data: HIT-UAV (CC0-1.0); AIResQ Benchmark (CC-BY-4.0); WiSARD thermal (MIT); AOS thermal integral images, Kurmi & Bimber, Zenodo 6382373 (CC-BY-4.0); RGB-LWIR Labeled Dataset for Air-based platforms, Gallagher & Oughton, Zenodo 7465521 (CC-BY-4.0)
teacher: hae-s-ir-ext: same architecture as hae-s-ir (313,169 parameters), trained by the hae authors from scratch for 90 epochs on the same five-dataset mix; not released. No third-party weights were used at any stage.
